decisions.title: 2013-2021 General Obligation Bond Summary
decisions.description: Summarizes planned 2013-2021 general-obligation bond totals by City department, including streets, drainage, parks, public safety, transit, community facilities, neighborhood set-asides, and public art.
decisions.provenance_status: official City Plone document-library listing and direct item URL recorded
processing_notes: Original two-page City PDF visually reviewed because it has no usable text layer.
It reports annual 2013, 2015, 2017, 2019, and 2021 bond totals by department and a $701.186 million grand total.
